Recipes

A recipe is the knowledge of how to make a particular thing. It tells you which crafting ability permits the work, what tools and materials you need, how long an attempt takes, and what the result produces. Knowing a recipe does not supply its ingredients or grant the ability needed to use it.

Read the entry before beginning. A project may accumulate progress toward a completion target; a supply recipe may instead raise an existing inventory die. Follow the printed outcomes and limits. Starting crafting abilities provide their stated recipe choices; you can learn further compatible recipes through the appropriate ability or discover them during play.

Granted by tells you how a recipe enters your repertoire. Used with lists abilities that can carry out its work. Ordinary Recipe Study grants two compatible recipes, but you must already know an ability that can use them.

For every recipe, roll the crafting ability’s printed attribute at the end of an attempt. Work alone; there is no group crafting. Accumulate project progress until you meet the completion target. For supplies, the first inventory step from empty creates d4; later steps are d6, d8, d10, d12 and d20, up to the recipe’s cap. Check any carried material supply after each attempt. You must actually obtain the ingredients; recipe knowledge supplies no free stock. Recipes remain known for reuse. The plants and mixtures here are fictional game ingredients.
